latency_note: per chip of 256x256 px, one chip per call, including the gate decision but not the NDVI computation, which the pipeline needs anyway. Only meaningful alongside the device. Run-to-run drift on this GPU is about 0.8 ms per chip, which is an order of magnitude larger than the difference between the gated and ungated configurations: measured in both orders they agree to within 0.07 ms, so the gate has no latency effect that this harness can resolve. Do not report a latency difference between those two rows.
label_provenance: Hansen GFC weak labels; measures agreement with Hansen, not field accuracy
protocol: threshold tuned on val and applied to test; ignore pixels excluded
